prompt: Write a recorded statement transcript (about 250 words) between an insurance adjuster (lines start with 'Q:') and the claimant (lines start with 'A:'). The claimant was the driver in a hit while turning left in Houston, Texas, and has neck and back strain. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1427; do not mention it.)
text:
Q: This is the adjuster speaking. Is it all right if I record this statement for the claim file?

A: Yes, that's fine.

Q: Please state your full name for the recording.

A: I'd rather just go by my first name for now, if that's okay.

Q: That's fine. Can you tell me where you were when the accident happened?

A: I was in Houston, Texas, driving through an intersection on a fairly busy road. I was turning left onto a side street.

Q: What was the traffic like at that moment?

A: It was moderate. There was a car coming toward me from the other direction, and I thought I had enough room to make the turn.

Q: What happened next?

A: The other vehicle came through the intersection faster than I expected and hit the passenger side of my car. My car spun a little and stopped against the curb.

Q: Were you able to get out of the vehicle?

A: Yes, I got out on my own, but I felt stiff almost right away.

Q: Did you seek medical attention?

A: Yes, I went to an urgent care clinic that same day. They diagnosed me with a neck strain and a back strain. I've been doing physical therapy twice a week since then.

Q: How are your symptoms today?

A: The neck is still sore when I turn my head to the right, and my lower back aches after I've been sitting for more than an hour. Some days are better than others.

Q: Have you missed any work because of the injuries?

A: I've missed a few shifts, and I've had to limit how much I lift at the job.

Q: Is there anything else you think I should know about the accident?

A: Only that I want to cooperate fully. I'll send over the clinic records and the repair estimate for my car as soon as I have them.

Q: Thank you. This concludes the statement.

A: Thanks, I appreciate your time.
